page.overview:
Who is Cynthia Strode?

Mason Strode (husband; deceased) Laurie Strode (adopted daughter; deceased)

She is part of the continuity of the remake series and appears in the 2007 film by director Rob Zombie. She is the adoptive mother of Laurie Strode.

In the early 1990s, Cynthia and Mason Strode adopted a baby girl whom they named Laurie. They were unaware of her relation to the Myers family as she was dropped off at the hospital by Mason's friend Lee Brackett after Deborah Myers' suicide.

Sheriff Brackett did not want the baby to carry the stigma of her family, so he omitted her from the records of what had happened with the Myers family. Cynthia and her husband raised Laurie with a normal life.
